what_this_is: Songs removed from the VenuePlay musical bingo library and never to be added back, whatever a chart says.
decided_by: Dean, 10 Sep 2026: "pull glitter and harris." then "just put them in a never to return folder i guess."
why: Nothing in the song pipeline asks whether a song is a PROBLEM. It asks whether it charted, whether it has a preview clip, whether the title is explicit. So these walked into three packs inside 805 chart additions on 9 Sep 2026 purely because they charted, and sat live on the site until somebody read the list. Both men are convicted sex offenders. Most Australian radio will not play either, and one of these coming up on a bingo card in a pub is not a music problem, it is a phone call to Dean.
how_it_is_enforced: tools/pull-from-packs.py holds PULL_ARTISTS and matches on the ARTIST, not a song id, because matching by id would miss the same act under a different title. venueplay/app/song-excluded-acts.test.js fails the gate if any of them reaches a pack again.
